outer_folds: Five saved training folds; final test set not used
inner_seed: 42 + outer fold number; final all-training search uses 42
xgboost: 100 trees, learning rate 0.05, 32 histogram bins, half candidate features per tree; depth in [2, 3]
preprocessing: Fold-local log1p and variance threshold 1e-8; logistic also standardizes within each fold
imbalance: Balanced class weights for logistic/forest; XGBoost recomputes sample weights at every fit
limitations: Small bounded grids; logistic formulation and tree compute budgets differ from initial pilots. Initial-to-tuned differences cannot be attributed solely to tuning.
